'''Frank's daughter''' is a character {{In|FOTV}}.

==''Fallout'' TV series==
===[[The End (episode)|The End]]===
At [[Roy Spencer]]'s birthday party, Frank's daughter sits amongst the [[birthday party guest]]s and watches [[The Ghoul|Cooper Howard]] perform a lasso trick for them all on his horse, [[Sugarfoot]].

Afterward, she joins the other party guests to watch TV in the living room until the bomb with the far away distance drops. After this, she follows her father [[Frank (TV series)|Frank]] to try and join the Spencer family in their fallout shelter. However, Roy's father [[Bob Spencer|Bob]] punches out her father and leaves him on the ground.

==Appearances==
Frank's daughter appears only {{in|FOTV}}.
